schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs (and the only print of the 0–6 language deduction); 4–7 transcript (never shown to students; PDF 7 then begins the answers); 7–9 listening answers, the Fógra a hAon grid answers printed after Fógra a Dó, ending with the mark-total boxes; 10–11 composition marking and the 40-mark table; 31–32 modified marking (SMM, incl. the composition 40-mark bands). PDF 12–30 are Paper 2; 33–35 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (the 2021 Paper 1 is an 8-page question booklet; page 8 is blank) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

audio.note: One SEC recording serves the Higher and Ordinary 2021 listening test; Ordinary asks different questions on the same extracts. The 2021 listening cards already play it.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening answers with alternatives (e.g. Cois trá / Ar an trá/trá / Cois farraige) are accepted answers to one task, not routes.

Card unit for listening: the six retained legacy segment cards keep their IDs and stay the card unit, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (20 questions at 3, the four Fógra a hAon grid questions included; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card (already carded, IDs retained). Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email, recipient (deartháir/deirfiúr) and conversation partner wording stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6; every question 3 marks) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3 in 2021; it is one section-level deduction, and cards state it without applying it.

Fógra a hAon is a printed grid (“Líon isteach an t-eolas atá á lorg sa ghreille anseo.”) of four unnumbered questions; the scheme prints their answers after Fógra a Dó on PDF 7, each as “answer 3 mharc” followed by alternatives. Each grid question is its own criterion (labelled Greille 1–4 in the app).

The paper prints Comhrá a hAon, An Chéad Mhír, Ceist 2 as “Cá dtéadh Nuala agus a muintir …”; the scheme heads the same answers “Cá dtéadh Nuala agus a deartháireacha …”. The card shows the paper’s wording.
The 2021 scheme prints no general listening note, no annotation-symbol page for the composition and no short-attempt (M/F1/F2/F3) columns.
The paper prints the composition Treoracha on page 6 and the choice and titles on page 7; the composition cards show both pages.

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): each segment card had one undivided criterion; the nine composition cards carried the 2021–2022 legacy composition text. All now carry the lifted 2021 scheme text and per-question tariffs.
